long_biography.plain_text:
Igor Vicel helped build SLOV-MATIC into a Slovak operator of gambling halls and video-lottery terminals. He controlled the company with two partners from its creation and spent more than two decades as a managing director before joining its supervisory board.

Beyond the company, Vicel served as head of Slovakia’s Association of Entertainment and Games, representing operators in public debates about taxation, municipal restrictions and illegal gambling. A 2020 ownership reorganisation brought the Czech Synot group into joint control. The arrangement received conditional regulatory approval in 2023, shifting SLOV-MATIC from its original shareholder group to a cross-border partnership.

The arrangement received conditional regulatory approval in 2023, shifting SLOV-MATIC from its original shareholder group to a cross-border partnership.
